about: Time-sensitive question evaluation. Four contacts (the 经理 relation and work domains give facts without a model) and eight things the user said in the channel over two months, each also remembered as a memory. Each query asks for a fact whose current value is known; stale lists the values it replaced. A memory-only answer takes the top memory; a fact answer takes the first fact listed for the question. The chat lines are in the phrasings the scripted extraction rules cover, written by the same author, so the fact figures are optimistic; a real model's extraction is unmeasured.
